purpose: Read-only source discovery and bounded public-service validation; no runtime or global changes.
assessment: The official Hohhot bureau notice confirms free visual cadastral-map lookup for anyone via the registration center's WeChat public account, but the notice page contains no QR/H5 link. Its sole attachment endpoint returned HTTP 200 text/plain with a short failure response rather than a PDF. The actual WeChat interface/API remains inaccessible from the disclosed web path; no public full-vector endpoint or sample geometry was verified. Remaining uncertainty: whether the WeChat service exposes an anonymous polygon API and whether the WUP point is in coverage.
